```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyterra)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 9))
theme_update(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
nice_titles <- as_labeller(function(x) {str_wrap(str_replace_all(x, "_", " "),10)})

binomial_smooth <- function(...) {
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), ...)
}
```

## Background  

Pemba Island, Tanzania is nearing elimination of schistosomiasis. Here we use risk maps derived from 2012, 2019, and 2025 to compare risk to human-case data. 

## Input layers  

```{r}
## files in folder
fl <- list.files("G:/My Drive/De Leo Lab/projects/InVEST_schisto/InVEST_scenario_data/zanzibar/GEEexports", full.names = T)

## load files
region_aoi <- vect(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "shp"))])
r_ndvi_dry <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "NDVI_dry"))])
r_ndvi_wet <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "NDVI_wet"))])
r_temp_dry <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "waterTemp_dry"))])
r_temp_wet <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "waterTemp_wet"))])
r_temp_dry_BT <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "waterTemp_BT_dry"))])
r_temp_wet_BT <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "waterTemp_BT_wet"))])
r_water <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "water_mask"))])
r_pop <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "worldpop"))])

## give layers names based on data/year
rename_layers <- function(rstack){
  nms <- names(rstack)
  srcs <- sources(rstack)
  
  srcs <- str_extract(srcs, "[^/]+$")
  srcs <- str_remove(srcs, ".tif")
  srcs <- str_remove(srcs, "habsuit_")
  
  names(rstack) <- srcs
  
  rstack
}

r_ndvi_dry <- rename_layers(r_ndvi_dry)
r_ndvi_wet <- rename_layers(r_ndvi_wet)
r_temp_dry <- rename_layers(r_temp_dry)
r_temp_wet <- rename_layers(r_temp_wet)
r_temp_dry_BT <- rename_layers(r_temp_dry_BT)
r_temp_wet_BT <- rename_layers(r_temp_wet_BT)
r_water <- rename_layers(r_water)
r_pop <- rename_layers(r_pop)

## mask areas outside of aoi
r_ndvi_dry <- mask(r_ndvi_dry, region_aoi)
r_ndvi_wet <- mask(r_ndvi_wet, region_aoi)
r_temp_dry <- mask(r_temp_dry, region_aoi)
r_temp_wet <- mask(r_temp_wet, region_aoi)
r_temp_dry_BT <- mask(r_temp_dry_BT, region_aoi)
r_temp_wet_BT <- mask(r_temp_wet_BT, region_aoi)
r_water <- mask(r_water, region_aoi)
r_pop <- mask(r_pop, region_aoi)

## water 0,1
r_water[r_water>0] = 1
r_water = as.factor(r_water)
```

```{r riskdat}
fl <- list.files("G:/My Drive/De Leo Lab/projects/InVEST_schisto/InVEST_scenario_data/zanzibar/InVEST_layers", full.names = T)
fl <- fl[which(str_detect(fl, "tif"))]
fl <- fl[-which(str_detect(fl, "unmasked"))]

r_risk <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "risk"))])
r_suit <- rast(fl[which(str_detect(fl, "suit"))])
```

### AOI  
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=region_aoi) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4)


```
The total area of the Pemba AOI is `r sum(expanse(region_aoi, unit="km"))` km^2. The wikipedia pages say 988 km^2

### Water presence  

```{r}
## maps
ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data=r_water) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, labeller = nice_titles) +
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`0` = "grey", `1` = "navy"), na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(fill="Water")

## annual amount of water
tmp <- global(r_water, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(diff_yi_y1 = sum - first(sum),
         diff_yi_yim1 = sum - lag(sum),
         across(sum:diff_yi_yim1, ~.* 1e-5)) %>% ## convert 10m2 to km2
  ## name a year col instead of layer name
  rownames_to_column(var= "lyr_name") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_sub(lyr_name, -4, -1))) 

### plot annual changes
tmp %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y=sum)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y=expression("Water area "~(km^2))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = tmp$year)

## summary table of annual changes
tmp %>% 
  select(year, sum, diff_yi_y1, diff_yi_yim1) %>% 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, col.names = c("Year", "Water area", 
                                         "$y_i - y_1$",
                                         "$y_i - y_{i-1}$"),
               escape = FALSE,
               caption = "units = $km^2$")

## summary map of where changes occur
ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data=app(r_water, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(fill="N years with water")

## summary table of where changes occur
table(values(app(r_water, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("N years with water", "Freq"))
```

### Compare convolved hab risk to snail data  
```{r}
fp_z <- "G:/Shared drives/Belmont-CEH2/Data/Zanzibar/"

zest_snails <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "ZEST/ZEST_SNAIL_DATA_MAIN_v23_2021-01-11-v1_Giulio_(2.7.2026).csv"))
schistobreak_snails <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "SchistoBreak/SchistoBreak_Snail_WB_Intv_14.01.2026.csv"))

paste("missing coords for",
      zest_snails %>% filter(island == "Pemba", is.na(longi_dd) | is.na(lati_dd)) %>% nrow(),
      "observations in ZEST snails")

paste("missing coords for",
      schistobreak_snails %>% filter(is.na(longitude_gps) | is.na(latitude_gps)) %>% nrow(),
      "observations in SchistoBreak snails")

## make spatial
zest_snails <- zest_snails %>% 
  filter(island == "Pemba", !is.na(longi_dd), !is.na(lati_dd)) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longi_dd", "lati_dd"), crs=4326) %>% 
  st_transform(crs=crs(r_risk))

schistobreak_snails <- schistobreak_snails %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude_gps", "latitude_gps"), crs=4326) %>% 
  st_transform(crs=crs(r_risk))

## bind to risk
tmp <- extract(r_risk_cov_hab, zest_snails, ID=F)
zest_snails <- cbind(zest_snails, tmp)

tmp <- extract(r_risk_cov_hab, schistobreak_snails, ID=F)
schistobreak_snails <- cbind(schistobreak_snails, tmp)
```

### ZEST snails
```{r}
## ZEST analysis
tmp <- zest_snails %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(year, no_collected, bglob, infsnails_no, starts_with("convolved")) %>% 
  select(-convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp_unmodifiedWater) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.factor(year),
         no_collected_lp = log(no_collected + 1)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("convolved"), names_to = "layer", values_to = "values") %>% 
  mutate(values_z = scale(values),
         infsnail_01 = ifelse(infsnails_no > 0, 1, infsnails_no))

## plot ZEST -- snail presence
tmp %>% 
  mutate(layer = str_remove_all(layer, "convolved_hab_risk_2019_")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=values_z, y=bglob, col=layer)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, pch="|") +
  # geom_smooth(se=F, method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial")) +
  binomial_smooth(se=F) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(x= "Convolved habitat risk 2019 (scaled and centered)", y = "B. globosus found",
       title = "Bg found")

## model ZEST -- snail presence
print("B. globosus present")
mod_BT <- MASS::glm.nb(bglob ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2017, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_BTtemp"))
mod_L8 <- MASS::glm.nb(bglob ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2017, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp"))
mod_NO <- MASS::glm.nb(bglob ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2017, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_NOtemp"))
# DHARMa::simulateResiduals(mod_BT, n=999, plot=T)
AIC(mod_BT, mod_L8, mod_NO)

## plot ZEST -- snail infection (only ~50 tested)
tmp %>% 
  mutate(layer = str_remove_all(layer, "convolved_hab_risk_2019_")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(infsnail_01)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=values_z, y=infsnail_01, col=layer)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2, pch="|") +
  # geom_smooth(se=F, method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial")) +
  binomial_smooth(se=F) +
  # facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(x= "Convolved habitat risk 2019 (scaled and centered)", y = "Infected snails found",
       title = "Bg infected (very few tested)")
```

### SchistoBreak Snails
```{r}
## SchistoBreak analysis
tmp <- schistobreak_snails %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_sub(date, -4, -1))) %>% 
  select(year, bg, bgpos, starts_with("convolved")) %>% 
  select(-convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp_unmodifiedWater) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.factor(year),
         no_collected_lp = log(bg + 1)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("convolved"), names_to = "layer", values_to = "values") %>% 
  mutate(values_z = scale(values))

## plot SB -- count of snails
print("B. globosus present")
tmp %>% 
  mutate(layer = str_remove_all(layer, "convolved_hab_risk_2019_")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=values_z, y=no_collected_lp, col=layer)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, pch="|") +
  geom_smooth(se=F, method = "lm") +
  # binomial_smooth(se=F) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(x= "Convolved habitat risk 2019 (scaled and centered)", y = "B. globosus N found (ln+1)",
       title = "Bg found")

## model SB
mod_BT <- MASS::glm.nb(bg ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_BTtemp"))
mod_L8 <- MASS::glm.nb(bg ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp"))
mod_NO <- MASS::glm.nb(bg ~ values_z*factor(year), data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_NOtemp"))
# DHARMa::simulateResiduals(mod_BT, n=999, plot=T)
AIC(mod_BT, mod_L8, mod_NO)

## plot SB -- infected snails
print("B. globosus infected")
tmp %>% 
  filter(!is.na(bgpos)) %>% 
  mutate(layer = str_remove_all(layer, "convolved_hab_risk_2019_")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=values_z, y=bgpos, col=layer)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, pch="|") +
  # geom_smooth(se=F, method = "lm") +
  binomial_smooth(se=F) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(x= "Convolved habitat risk 2019 (scaled and centered)", y = "B. globosus N infected",
       title = "Bg infected")

## model SB
mod_BT <- glm(bgpos ~ values_z*factor(year), family="binomial", data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_BTtemp",
                               !is.na(bgpos)))
mod_L8 <- glm(bgpos ~ values_z*factor(year), family="binomial", data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp",
                               !is.na(bgpos)))
mod_NO <- glm(bgpos ~ values_z*factor(year), family="binomial", data=tmp %>% 
                        filter(year != 2024, layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_NOtemp",
                               !is.na(bgpos)))
# DHARMa::simulateResiduals(mod_BT, n=999, plot=T)
AIC(mod_BT, mod_L8, mod_NO)
```

### Compare to prevalence data (schools only) 
```{r}
# zest_adults <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "ZEST/Merged_datasets_Adults_Unguja_Pemba_2012-2021_v28_FINAL_plus_MDA_(27.04.2021)_SK-v1_Giulio_(1.7.2026).csv"))
zest_schools <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "ZEST/Merged_datasets_Schools_Unguja_Pemba_2012-2021_v36_FINAL_plus_MDA_GPS_short_(27.10.2021)_SK-v1_Giulio_(1.7.2026).csv"))

# sb_comm <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "SchistoBreak/SchistoBreak_Community_2021-2024_v1_Giulio_(3.9.2026).csv"))
# sb_schools <- read.csv(paste0(fp_z, "SchistoBreak/SchistoBreak_School_2020-2024_v1_Giulio_(3.9.2026).csv"))

## schools are revisted, but don't have GPS each time
zsloc <- zest_schools %>% 
  filter(isl == "Pemba", !is.na(lat), !is.na(longitude)) %>% ## remove one school w/o coords
  select(school, shehia_of_school, district, lat, longitude) %>% 
  distinct()

zest_schools <- zest_schools %>% 
  filter(isl == "Pemba") %>% 
  group_by(school, shehia_of_school, district, year) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), 
            n_tested = n - (sum(is.na(shpos))), ## assume NA = not tested
            shpos = sum(shpos, na.rm=T),
            .groups ="drop") %>% 
  left_join(zsloc) %>% 
  # filter(!is.na(lat)) %>% filter(school == "PANDANI")
  ## fill in the missing coordinates b/c I think its the same school
  mutate(lat = ifelse(is.na(lat), zsloc %>% filter(school == "PANDANI") %>% pull(lat), lat),
         longitude = ifelse(is.na(longitude), zsloc %>% filter(school == "PANDANI") %>% pull(longitude), longitude),)
```

### ZEST schools
```{r}
## ZEST analysis
tmp <- zest_schools %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(-convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp_unmodifiedWater) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.factor(year)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("convolved"), names_to = "layer", values_to = "values") %>% 
  mutate(values_z = scale(values),
         prop_pos = shpos/n_tested,
         shpos_01 = ifelse(shpos > 0, 1, shpos))

## plot ZEST -- schools BINARY
tmp %>% 
  mutate(layer = str_remove_all(layer, "convolved_hab_risk_2019_")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=values_z, y=shpos_01, col=year)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, pch="|") +
  # geom_smooth(se=F, method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial")) +
  binomial_smooth(se=F) +
  facet_wrap(~layer) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = heat.colors(length(unique(zest_schools$year)))) +
  labs(x= "Convolved habitat risk 2019 (scaled and centered)", y = "Sh positive",
       title = "Sh positive - Any positives")

                        filter(layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_L8temp"))

                        filter(layer == "convolved_hab_risk_2019_NOtemp"))
```
